<function name="SetTargetEntity" parent="ProjectedTexture" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the target entity for this projected texture, meaning it will only be lighting the given entity and the world.

<validate>You must call <page>ProjectedTexture:Update</page> after using this function for it to take effect.</validate>
	</description>
	<added>2021.03.31</added>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="target" type="Entity" default="NULL">The target entity, or `NULL` to reset.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
